properties.label_detail_en: A-Group graves at Faras (GHA II ch.9 p.245: pot from an A-Group grave at Faras; p.249: A-Group graves at Faras of the reign of Djer and Ouadji). GHA II p.245 puts definite A-Group remains between the First Cataract and Batn el-Hagar; that range is not drawn. Dates are the era bracket. Faras: Wikidata Q584387 = Pleiades 795838 = GeoNames 363416. Point only, not a border.
